source: Yahoo Finance daily bars, split-adjusted, requested from 1990-01-01

overnight_gap.def_en: open over the previous close when the previous session was one or two days earlier
overnight_gap.def_zh: 停市一两天后，开盘价相对前一收盘价的涨跌

weekend_gap.def_en: open over the previous close when the previous session was three or more days earlier
weekend_gap.def_zh: 停市三天及以上（周末或长假）后，开盘价相对前一收盘价的涨跌

one_day.def_zh: 收盘价相对前一收盘价

weekend_close.def_en: close of the first session when the previous session was three or more days earlier, over the close before it
weekend_close.def_zh: 停市三天及以上之后第一个交易日的收盘价，相对停市前的收盘价

five_day.def_en: close over the close five sessions earlier (windows overlap)
five_day.def_zh: 收盘价相对五个交易日前的收盘价（窗口相互重叠）

MO.why: Philip Morris International was spun off to Altria holders on 28 Mar 2008; the provider shows it as a 70% fall.

MDLZ.why: Kraft Foods Group was spun off on 1 Oct 2012; the provider shows it as a 34% fall.

TMUS.why: The TMUS ticker belonged to MetroPCS until the 1 May 2013 merger; earlier bars are a different company.

adjusted.why: Kraft Foods Group was spun off on 1 Oct 2012; the provider shows it as a 34% fall.
Philip Morris International was spun off to Altria holders on 28 Mar 2008; the provider shows it as a 70% fall.
The TMUS ticker belonged to MetroPCS until the 1 May 2013 merger; earlier bars are a different company.
